_comment: Declarative battery-critical defense. Source of truth for the sysfs-direct battery watchdog. Bypasses upowerd/PowerDevil so a SAM voltage glitch (intermittent voltage=0 → percentage=NaN) cannot prevent hibernation. Nix module `configuration_system-protection-battery.nix` reads this file and generates a systemd timer + service that polls /sys/class/power_supply/<device>/{capacity,status} directly and triggers `systemctl <action_at_critical>` when conditions match.

watch._comment: Source data is the kernel's `capacity` integer (0..100), which comes from a separate code path than the energy/voltage fields upowerd computes from. capacity has been clean across all journal logs even when voltage/percentage went NaN.

thresholds._comment: Trigger only when status is `Discharging`. Critical fires the action; low only logs a warning.

action_at_critical._comment: systemctl verb to invoke when critical_capacity is hit + status matches require_status. Allowed: hibernate, suspend-then-hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend, poweroff. Default `hibernate` requires `resume=` on kernel cmdline (see hardware_filesystems.nix).

testers._comment: Each tester verifies one invariant of the battery defense. Wire into reports-logs or a dedicated CI job.

checks.description: Kernel cmdline has resume= so hibernation can resume on next boot
